levels.surface: أبو أحمد هاني بن محمد بن محمود العبدي

notes: «- رَفَعَهُ -» is an editor's gloss and is left out. «بإسناده» points to Muhammad b. Mahmud's own isnad, which this text does not write out. Musa b. Ja'far sits after «إلى» inside the chain, so he is a narrator.
needs_ruling: the saying contains a second isnad («أخبرني أبي، عن آبائه، عن جده رسول الله») and a narrated encounter with al-Rashid; neither is written as a route.
